newsitem.title: USA: Time Warner to cut budget by 3-5 pct - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Time Warner to cut budget by 3-5 pct - WSJ.

text.p: Time Warner Inc has ordered companywide budget cuts of three to five percent over three years, the Wall Street Journal said in its electronic edition Friday.
The savings would come mainly from spending cuts rather than job cuts, the report said, citing internal company memos.
"This is a companywide effort," Time Warner Chief Financial Officer Richard Bressler told the paper.
The report said new budget targets and aggressive growth goals have been given to Time Warner's operations, including cable, publishing and the music and film divisions.
According to the report, the savings include cutting back the number of company aircraft, less spending on annual meetings and eliminating glossy quarterly reports for shareholders.
Time Warner shares closed down $3/4 Thursday at $41.
